data.exact_reserve_text: The movements in 2016 have been affected by the change in the Ogden discount rate from 2.5% to minus 0.75% causing deteriorations in the gross position. The net impact to the syndicate is reduced due to the benefit of reinsurance.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2016 was GBP 570.85m. Prior-year development in 2016 resulted in a net prior-year release of approximately GBP 11.506m (around 2.0% of opening reserves). Management state that movements were materially affected by the revision to the Ogden discount rate which worsened the gross position, with the adverse impact reduced by reinsurance. The book remains predominantly motor business and the reserve movement is therefore driven by motor long-tail injury exposure and legal/discount rate developments.
raw_causal_phrases: The movements in 2016 have been affected by the change in the Ogden discount rate from 2.5% to minus 0.75% causing deteriorations in the gross position.
The net impact to the syndicate is reduced due to the benefit of reinsurance.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development: the primary 'Movement in prior accident year's provision' note in the report presents a total labelled as net movements; no explicit gross prior-year movement figure is provided. A net prior-year release of GBP 11.506k is reported in that note and has been used (NET-of-reinsurance fallback) because no unequivocal gross prior-year movement amount was available. The gross claims development triangle is present and shows individual older underwriting years (2011-2014) with no change on their previous diagonals (i.e. zero aggregate movement for those explicit individual years), but an aggregate 'X and prior' column exists and may contain movements not separately disclosed; the aggregate column was excluded per instructions. As a result there is some ambiguity whether the reported net release arises from gross movements in the aggregated earlier years or from reinsurance recoveries; users should treat the prior-year movement figure as NET-based and flagged accordingly.
